Sonnet claimed citizen early and kept pressing Gemma, who dodged questions and never claimed a role. The big mistake came on day one, when the town voted out Haiku, a citizen, after Haiku pushed hard on Sonnet and then accused Gemma. The turning point was day two, when the town voted out Sol, a killer, and the pressure shifted to Luna, the officer, who refused to answer anyone. Day three voted out Sonnet, and that night the killers took Luna, leaving Gemma and Terra one each, which was all the killers needed. Gemma, who said the least, won the game.
